title: STEP LOG -- one seat's step-by-step INPUT/OUTPUT record of one end-to-end pass of the canonical fabric workflow, written at the round's L10 stamp; the CTO compiles every seat's step log against the spine into four quadrants
description: Authority: Andrew-direct at the 2.0.0_SA_COO terminal 2026-09-03 ~04:2xZ (record org/tier1_exec/2.0.0_SA_COO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260903_042xZ_PER_AGENT_STEP_LOGS_INPUT_OUTPUT_FOR_CTO_LOOP_COMPILATION.md); schema fixed by 1.0.0_SA_CTO as the compiler. THE SEAT RECORDS ACTS; IT NEVER SELF-ASSIGNS A QUADRANT. The quadrant is derived by the compiler from two orthogonal axes read against the spine (org/ref/CANONICAL_FABRIC_WORKFLOW_20260901.md): plan_conformance {ON_PLAN, OFF_PLAN} x outcome {EFFICIENT, DEFICIENT}. ON_PLAN x EFFICIENT = the loop worked; ON_PLAN x DEFICIENT = a plan-improvement opportunity; OFF_PLAN x EFFICIENT = allowed flexibility or a plan improvement; OFF_PLAN x DEFICIENT = a GATE CANDIDATE. Rule 24 on the two axes: (i) each is two members, exhaustive by negation; (ii) one grain, one recorded act; (iii) one intent each -- did the act follow a spine clause / did the act reach its output without waste or failure; (iv) a plan amendment moves the conformance axis for future acts, a gate moves the deficient off-plan cell to refused, neither rewrites a recorded act. One file per seat per project per round at org/missions/D<n>/<MACRO>/<CODE>/ledger/STEP_LOG.<serial>.round<N>.json (lane ANY on ledger/). Nothing about this file gates the L10 stamp.

trigger.description: the L10 stamp this log answers to: the remediation row id or the round-close record, as a locator

rows.description: ONE ROW PER ACT, in the order performed. An act is one thing the seat did that produced or consumed an artifact or a message: a skill run, a commit, a dispatch, a grade, a relay, an ack, a hold.

limb.description: the limb the act belongs to per the spine; X = an act outside the ten limbs (a push window, a relay, a startup, a hold). The seat states the limb it BELIEVED it was in; the compiler compares that against the spine's owner for the limb.

act.description: what was done, one line, in the seat's own words

inputs.description: what the act consumed: artifacts at a vintage, messages by id, a sovereign word by its record. An empty list is legal and says the act consumed nothing on the record.

outputs.description: what the act produced: artifacts at a commit, messages by id, a record. An act with no output is a hold or a read; say so in `act`.

spine_clause.description: the spine section the act followed (e.g. 'L6 gate', 'L7 surprise', 'section 2 role exclusivity'), or NONE when the seat followed no clause. NONE is a record, not a confession; the compiler classifies.

gate_or_notifier_touched.description: the gate that refused or admitted, or the notifier that fired, if any -- with its verdict as printed

note.description: one line; what the next reader needs and nothing else

ref.description: ARTIFACT: <path>@<commit>; MESSAGE: the broker message id; RECORD: <path>@<commit>; WORD: the record that carries the sovereign word; GATE_OUTPUT: the gate name + its verdict line

compiler_output.description: NOT part of a seat's instance; the shape the CTO's compilation emits per row so the four quadrants are data, not prose.

per_row.discriminator: the spine clause or the measured fact that decided both axes

compiler_output.denominators: rows per seat and per limb; rows per quadrant; every count with its frame
